faq.a: Southaven at 3315, 3317 and 3319 148 Street was built 2023–2024 by Park Ridge Homes, per the MLS® strata building record.
Southaven is 5 and 6 storeys with About 163 condos plus nine townhomes.
A fitness centre, games room with billiards and ping pong, a social lounge with a kitchenette, a meeting room and more than 7,000 sq ft of outdoor space with a barbecue area.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: A fitness centre, games room with billiards and ping pong, a social lounge with a kitchenette, a meeting room and more than 7,000 sq ft of outdoor space with a barbecue area.
Southaven is in the King George Corridor, near Southpoint and Highway 99. Being new, the homes carry the remaining BC new home warranty; ask the seller for the warranty documents.

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Southaven owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
